name: ProofPins
author: tonyjordan68

sections.description:
ProofPins is a local business check-in service for WordPress. This plugin lets your office check in each finished job: it becomes a page on your own website, with the photos, a short write-up, the service and the town, and a pin on your service-area map.

It is built for service businesses that go to the customer: roofers, remodelers, mobile mechanics, cleaners, detailers and other trades. Visitors see that you work in their town. They never see the customer’s address.

What it does

  • A page for every job. Add a job in WordPress with a title, a write-up, a service, a job date and photos. Each job gets its own page on your site.
  • A service-area map. The [proofpins_map] shortcode draws a map with one pin per published job, filter buttons for each service and a list of recent jobs.
  • Recent-jobs cards. The [proofpins_recent] shortcode shows your newest jobs as cards on any page, for one service or one town if you want.
  • Pins that protect your customers. You type an address, ZIP code or town once to place a pin. The pin is moved 60 to 150 meters (you choose the distance) before it is saved, and what you typed is not stored. Job pages show a circle over the general area, never a point on a house.
  • Photos without location data. Location and camera data are removed from every photo before it appears on a job page. A photo that cannot be cleaned is not shown.
  • Search title and description. Each job has a field for the title and the description that search engines show. If you use an SEO plugin, it stays in charge and ProofPins steps back.
  • Your pages stay yours. Jobs are ordinary WordPress content stored in your own database. If you stop using the plugin, nothing is held anywhere else.

Who it is for

Any business whose work happens at the customer’s location and who wants each finished job to show, on its own website, where it works and what it does there.

Free plugin and paid plans

This plugin is free and stays free. Everything described above works with no account, no time limit and no locked features.

ProofPins, Inc. also offers paid plans for businesses that want their crews to check in jobs from the field:

  • Starter: crew check-in from a phone link (no app), AI writes each job page from the photos and notes (50 a month), an SEO score with one-click fixes, pages for each town and service built from your jobs, and locked ZIP codes (one business per trade in each ZIP code).
  • Pro: everything in Starter, 150 AI write-ups a month, review requests by text and email, Google Business Profile, Facebook and Instagram posts written for each job and ready to share, and Google Maps rankings across your service area.
  • Platinum: everything in Pro with unlimited AI write-ups.

Paid plans work with job software such as CompanyCam and Jobber, run month to month and come with a 30-day money-back guarantee on the first payment. See ProofPins > Plans in your dashboard, or https://proofpins.com/#pricing for current prices. The free plugin never contacts ProofPins, Inc.; the Plans screen is only a page with a link.

External services

This plugin connects to two OpenStreetMap services. It does not connect to ProofPins, Inc. or to any other service.

OpenStreetMap map tiles. The maps on your site are drawn with image tiles from tile.openstreetmap.org. When a visitor opens a page that shows a ProofPins map, the visitor’s browser requests those tiles directly, which sends the visitor’s IP address, browser details and the area of the map being viewed to the OpenStreetMap Foundation. No tiles are requested on pages without a map. You can replace this service with your own map provider under ProofPins > Settings. Tile usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ . Terms of use: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use . Privacy policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy .

OpenStreetMap Nominatim. When someone editing a job types a location in the “Where was the job?” field and saves, your web server sends that text to nominatim.openstreetmap.org to find its coordinates, town, state and postal code. The request also carries your site address in the User-Agent header and the site language, as Nominatim’s usage policy requires. Nothing is sent when the field is left empty, or when latitude and longitude are typed instead of a place. The text typed is not stored by this plugin. Usage policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/ . Terms of use: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use . Privacy policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy .

Third-party libraries

  • Leaflet 1.9.4, BSD 2-Clause License, https://leafletjs.com/
  • Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3, MIT License, https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster

Both are included in the plugin in their distributed form. Their source is available at the addresses above.
sections.installation:
1. Install ProofPins from Plugins > Add New, or upload the zip file.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to ProofPins > Settings and enter your business name and phone number.
  4. Go to ProofPins > Add Job. Enter a title and a short write-up, choose a service, type where the job was, add photos and publish.
  5. Paste [proofpins_map] into the page where you want your service-area map.
sections.faq:
What is a local business check-in service?

A tool that turns each finished job into public proof that you work in a place: a check-in with photos, the town and the service. ProofPins publishes those check-ins as pages on your own WordPress site, with a privacy-blurred map pin.

Does ProofPins show my customers’ addresses?

No. Only the town, state and postal code appear, with a pin that has been moved away from the real location. The address you type to place a pin is used for one lookup and is not saved. Location data is removed from photos before they are shown.

How far is a pin moved?

Between 60% and 100% of the distance set under ProofPins > Settings (150 meters by default, up to 500). The direction is different for each job and stays the same every time that job is saved, so a pin does not jump around.

Will this get me ranked on Google?

Nobody can promise rankings. Job pages give search engines real, first-hand content about the services you do in each town. Results vary and take time.

Do I need an SEO plugin?

No. ProofPins prints the search title and description you enter for each job. If Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework is active, that plugin writes those tags and ProofPins does not.

Can I change the map tiles?

Yes. Enter your own provider’s tile address under ProofPins > Settings, or leave the field empty to use OpenStreetMap.

Will the plugin ask me to upgrade?

Once. After your fifth published job, the job list shows one short tip about the paid plans. Click “No thanks” and it never comes back. There is also a Plans screen under ProofPins and a small box on the job screen with a link to it. No feature in this plugin is locked.

What happens to my jobs if I deactivate the plugin?

They stay in your WordPress database. Reactivate the plugin and they are back on your site.
